newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves coal expansion project.
newsitem.headline: India approves coal expansion project.

text.p: India on Monday approved an expansion project of Northern Coalfields (NCL) for 18.47 billion rupees ($516 million), the government said.

Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's cabinet committee on economic affairs (CCEA) has approved the Nigahi opencast expansion project of NCL to 10 million tonnes from 4.2 million tonne per annum, it said in a statement.
The project is one of the 24 projects which will be financed by the World Bank under a coal sector rehabilitation project of state-run Coal India Ltd. -- New Delhi +91-11 301 2024
